content.text: {"answer": "No. A failed push to Utopia does not fail the ingest. The utopia-graph-mirror spec (FR4.4) says a CI caller posting a test-report delta still gets the same 200 response, with the usual `test_chunks` and `pruned_test_files` counts, when the Utopia mirror push fails. The failure is only reported to operators. It is logged as `[utopia-mirror] <repo> <path>: <message>`, and the `lore_utopia_mirror_failures_total` counter goes up. I found this wording for the test-report case. I did not confirm that the spec says the same for spec or ADR deltas, though the mirror appears to be designed as non-blocking.", "sources": ["specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md (FR4.4)"]}
